breakdown.description: Laminar boundary-layer correlation is applied at a Reynolds number where the boundary layer would be turbulent/transition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly instructs using the laminar relation δ = 5x/√(Re_x), directly repeating the original error. At Re_x = 2×10⁶ (well above the ~5×10⁵ transition threshold), the boundary layer is turbulent, and a turbulent correlation (e.g., δ ≈ 0.37 x Re_x^{-1/5}) should have been used instead. The agent did not identify or correct this inconsistency.
